projects.title: My Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- Personal Portfolio Website made in React
 -  Fully customisable and dynamic, easily change data and images.
 - Dark Mode Support

projects.title: Print Job Scheduler
projects.bodyText: - This C program is a simulation of a **print queue system** that supports different scheduling policies: **Priority, FIFO (First-In-First-Out), and SJN (Shortest Job Next)**. The system also includes authentication for computers trying to add print jobs.

projects.title: Store Management System
projects.bodyText: - The project, **Store Management System**, aims to provide a comprehensive database solution for managing branches, items, customers, employees, and suppliers in a retail chain. It includes **CRUD** operations, transaction tracking, stock management, and advanced database features like triggers, stored procedures, and views. A front-end using Streamlit enhances usability by enabling interactive access.

projects.title: 3D Viewer and Editor
projects.bodyText:
- Developed an interactive web application for uploading and manipulating **GLTF/GLB** files from local storage or **Firebase**.
- Added light controls, scene properties, mesh hierarchy, mesh-specific editing, model export, AR support, and animation playback.

projects.title: Automated Sketching with Robotic Arm
projects.bodyText:
- Designed a multimodal system that converts text or audio descriptions into visual sketches using a robotic arm.
- Built a pipeline for NLP interpretation, text-to-image generation, outline extraction, speech recognition, and secure serial communication with custom path planning.
- Optimized drawing precision for applications in forensics and creative automation.

projects.title: Secure Voice over IP System
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a real-time Voice over IP communication system in Python for secure audio streaming across a local network.
- Implemented SSL/TLS-encrypted socket communication, multithreaded client handling, and multi-client audio broadcasting.
- Used PyAudio to capture microphone input and play incoming audio with low latency.
